criteria.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section
criteria.final_justification: The action history indicates the agent intended to find “Best sellers,” but the screenshot evidence never confirms that section was found/visible. Since there’s no confirmed blocker either (site loads and scrolls), the score should not be increased beyond minimal credit for attempting to look via scrolling/navigating to /games.

criteria.criterion: Open a product page for a game from 'Best sellers'
criteria.final_justification: Opening the product page is clearly evidenced, but traceability to the “Best sellers” section is not visually verifiable from the screenshots. Given the criterion’s allowance for unclear traceability, award strong but not perfect credit.

criteria.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page
criteria.final_justification: All three required fields are visible in the product-page screenshot, but the agent failed to report the publisher and incorrectly stated it was unavailable. This is a substantive omission/contradiction, so credit should be reduced to reflect that only 2 of 3 were correctly reported despite the third being available.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in; no purchase or download; stop after recording details)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints appear fully respected: no sign-in, no buying/downloading. The agent stopped after providing an answer (even though incomplete), and no disallowed actions are evidenced. Keep full credit.
